findings.quote: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
findings.rationale: Unbounded exclusivity binds Customer for three years with no volume, pricing or performance conditions, and contradicts p0012 and p0050.

replacement.oldText: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
replacement.comment: Delete exclusivity in full; it contradicts Sections 2.1 and 12.3.

findings.quote: Customer shall offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best terms Customer offers any other technology supplier.
findings.rationale: MFN against Customer, unbounded and unauditable, implicitly requiring disclosure of other suppliers' confidential terms; inconsistent with p0050.

replacement.oldText: Customer shall offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best terms Customer offers any other technology supplier.
replacement.comment: Delete MFN clause in full; no substitute.

findings.quote: Customer shall pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as agreed liquidated damages for any delay in providing a dependency.
findings.rationale: Uncapped daily LDs against Customer with no definition of dependency, materiality, notice or cure; likely unenforceable penalty and non-reciprocal.

replacement.oldText: Customer shall pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as agreed liquidated damages for any delay in providing a dependency.
replacement.newText: If Customer fails to perform a dependency expressly identified in the applicable Order Form or implementation plan, and that failure actually and materially delays Vendor's performance, Vendor's affected dates will be extended day-for-day and Vendor may recover documented, reasonable idle-resource costs actually incurred, provided Vendor gave Customer written notice of the dependency failure and a reasonable opportunity (not less than ten business days) to cure. This is Vendor's sole remedy for Customer delay.
replacement.comment: Replace liquidated damages with an excusable-delay construct.

findings.quote: Each Order Form renews for twelve months unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
findings.rationale: Evergreen renewal with a 180-day non-renewal window is off-market; should be 30-60 days or renewal at Customer's election.

replacement.oldText: Each Order Form renews for twelve months unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
replacement.newText: Each Order Form expires at the end of its stated term unless Customer elects renewal in writing. If an Order Form provides for automatic renewal, either Party may prevent renewal by written notice at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term.

findings.quote: For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
findings.rationale: Unilateral 18-month no-hire covering Vendor's entire workforce, contradicting p0050's preservation of general recruitment hiring.

replacement.oldText: For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
replacement.newText: During the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party will knowingly solicit for employment any employee of the other who was directly and substantially engaged in performing or receiving the Services. This does not restrict general advertising, recruiter searches not targeted at the other Party, or hiring any person who responds to such efforts or who approaches a Party unsolicited.

findings.quote: Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
findings.rationale: Unlimited, unannounced, remote-access audit rights are unacceptable and contradict 22.2's bar on direct system access.

replacement.oldText: Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
replacement.newText: No more than once per twelve months, on at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, Vendor may verify Customer's usage of the Services. Verification will be conducted first by Customer self-certification based on Vendor's own usage telemetry; only if that is reasonably inconclusive may Vendor engage an independent auditor (not a Customer competitor) bound by confidentiality, during business hours, in a manner that does not disrupt Customer's operations. Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems, networks, or facilities directly. Vendor bears its own and the auditor's costs, subject to Section 22.2.

findings.quote: Either Party may terminate this Agreement or an affected Order Form for the other Party's material breach
findings.rationale: No Customer termination for convenience; exit only for breach, insolvency, security/SLA failures or force majeure.

findings.quote: Vendor warrants the Services and Deliverables will not contain malicious code intentionally introduced by Vendor
findings.rationale: Malicious-code warranty limited to intentionally introduced code, excluding negligently transmitted malware.

replacement.oldText: Vendor warrants the Services and Deliverables will not contain malicious code intentionally introduced by Vendor, and that Vendor will comply with Applicable Law.
replacement.newText: Vendor warrants the Services and Deliverables will be free of viruses, malware, and other malicious code, and that Vendor will use current-generation scanning tools to detect and prevent the same, and that Vendor will comply with Applicable Law.

findings.quote: professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000
findings.rationale: Cyber/E&O limits low against uncapped data/security liability and tail is only one year for claims-made policies.

replacement.comment: Extend tail to three years; consider cyber at USD 10M and E&O at USD 5M, Customer as additional insured on CGL with waiver of subrogation.

findings.quote: “Excluded Claims” means a Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations
findings.rationale: Cap is mutual but Excluded Claims are uncapped both ways, leaving Customer's indemnity/confidentiality exposure unlimited; consider a mutual super-cap.

findings.quote: refund prepaid and implementation Fees on a straight-line three-year basis
findings.rationale: Infringement refund amortization over three years may under-compensate; should track actual Order Form term and refund implementation Fees in full where unusable.

findings.quote: provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form
findings.rationale: Should be extendable by a further six months and expressly available even on termination for Customer non-payment if prepaid.

findings.quote: solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer
findings.rationale: "Improve" in 14.1 conflicts with 15.1's ban on model training and cross-customer combination; delete or subject to 15.1.

replacement.oldText: solely to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer
replacement.newText: solely to provide, secure, and support the Services for Customer

findings.quote: An Order Form prevails only for that Order Form and only when it expressly identifies the conflicting provision.
findings.rationale: Precedence order subordinates negotiated MSA to Order Forms and vendor exhibits; carve out core sections including licence terms.

findings.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor
findings.rationale: Assignment and change-of-control terms are customer-favourable; review raises no issue.

findings.quote: governed by the laws of the State of New York
findings.rationale: Review raises no objection to New York law and venue.

findings.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies.
findings.rationale: No minimum commitment imposed on Customer.

findings.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service
findings.rationale: No non-compete on Customer; clause expressly preserves freedom to operate.
